title: The Abilities Bridge WordPress plugin before 1.4.2 does not require a valid nonce before re-authenticating a REST API…
description: The Abilities Bridge WordPress plugin versions prior to 1.4.2 lack nonce validation when re-authenticating REST API requests from logged-in session cookies. This vulnerability enables attackers to perform Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks that can cause a logged-in administrator to execute arbitrary REST API actions, including creating new administrator accounts and taking over the site.
